feedback.problem: If $U={-80,-75,-70,…,30}$ is the universal set and $A={-80,-70,-60,…,30},$ then $\overset{―}{A}=$
feedback.worked_solution:
The complement of $A,$ denoted $\overset{―}{A},$ consists of every element in the universal set $U$ that is not in the set $A.$

The universal set $U$ consists of the multiples of $5$ from $-80$ through $30,$ while the set $A$ consists of the multiples of $10$ from $-80$ through $30.$

So, the only elements of $U$ that are not in $A$ are the multiples of $5$ from $-75$ through $25$ that are not multiples of $10.$

Therefore, the complement of $A$ is

$$
\overset{―}{A}={-75,-65,-55,…,25}.
$$
